content:
It seems to me that you did not copy your ~/Library/Thunderbird/ folder from your old Mac to the new Mac and paste in the equivalent location ~/Library/ here, which would have been the logic and simple migration mode. Obviously you installed and started Thunderbird on the new Mac, thus creating a virgin profile. Then you created your email accounts, IMAP and POP. An IMAP account automatically synchronises with the server, but a POP account can only download the messages still being on the POP server Inbox.

I advise to copy the account folder mail.oddplanetstudios.co.uk from your old to the new Mac where you paste it temporarily on your desktop. Exit Thunderbird if it is running, then go to ~/Library/Thunderbird/Profiles/xxxxxxxx.default-release/Mail/ and replace the existing folder mail.oddplanetstudios.co.uk with the copy from your desktop. When you restart Thunderbird you should find your POP account with its folders and messages in the same state as on the Monterey Mac.
